commands.name: crash_files
argv:
bash -c 'for d in /opt/usr/share/crash /opt/share/crash/dump /opt/share/crash; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then find "$d" -xdev -type f -printf '"'"'%p\t%s\t%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n'"'"'; fi; done | sort -u; r=$?; printf '"'"'
__PROBE_RC__%s
'"'"' "$r"'

commands.name: candidate_scan
argv:
bash -c 'for d in /opt/usr/apps/com.samsung.tv.slive-daemon/lib /lib /usr/lib /prd/usr/lib /usr/lib/was-api /usr/lib/ecore_imf/modules/isf/v-1.13 /usr/lib/gstreamer-1.0 /usr/lib/pulseaudio; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then find "$d" -xdev -type f -exec grep -alF .gnu.prelink_undo {} +; fi; done; r=$?; printf '"'"'
__PROBE_RC__%s
'"'"' "$r"'
